name: Comgrow (Shenzhen ZCSW Technology Co., Ltd.)
summary: Hong Kong-registered multi-brand 3D printing retailer founded in 2017, operating under the mainland entity Shenzhen ZCSW Technology Co., Ltd. Comgrow is an authorised Creality distributor that resells Creality filament (project-owner verified) and also sells own-brand COMGROW filament and accessories; it is a reseller/accessory brand rather than an independent extruder. A 2024 announcement indicates a merger with the related Sovol brand.

oem_relationships.notes: User-verified (research/verified-oem-relationships.md): Comgrow resells Creality filament and is not the manufacturer. Corroborated by Comgrow's own about-us page, which describes the company as an authorised distributor of Creality 3D printers.

Comgrow's about page describes Sovol as 'developed by their parent company', making the two sibling brands rather than supplier and customer. A 2024 company TikTok post announced a Comgrow/Sovol merger with Comgrow links redirecting to Sovol; independently unverified.

product_lines.name: PLA
product_lines.notes: Includes silk, chameleon and glow-in-the-dark variants

additional_notes: Registered address RM 023, 9/F BLK G Kwai Shing Industrial Building Stage 2, 42-46 Tai Lin Pai Road, Kwai Chung, NT, Hong Kong; legal entity Shenzhen ZCSW Technology Co., Ltd. Sells PEI plates, double-sided build plates and flexible steel plates, though these appear to be largely Creality-branded rather than Comgrow-branded, so makes_plates=true reflects that it sells plates rather than that it produces them; no plate_ids are asserted. Also retails Creality (Ender, K-series) and Sovol printers and SH01-SH03 filament dryers (from $59). Manufacturing origin is China for both own-brand and resold Creality filament.

provenance.conflicts: Brand identity is unstable: a 2024 company TikTok announcement describes a Comgrow/Sovol merger with Comgrow redirecting to Sovol, which is independently unverified and may make this entry a historical rather than a live brand. Whether Comgrow-branded filament is also Creality-produced (as opposed to only the explicitly resold Creality filament) is not established, and the build plates it sells are Creality-branded.
